about_the_game: This DLC adds a new layer to the existing story, offering deeper insight into Sani Yang’s experiments and their lasting consequences. It is designed to seamlessly expand the core narrative with untold details.

content_descriptors.notes: Some CGs suggest sexual relationship between the characters.

detailed_description: This DLC adds a new layer to the existing story, offering deeper insight into Sani Yang’s experiments and their lasting consequences. It is designed to seamlessly expand the core narrative with untold details.
name: Sani Yang's Laboratory - Secret Plus

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 3 or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 32MB or greater graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 64MB or greater graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Expand the narrative with new revelations in Sani Yang’s Laboratory, an additional detail that sheds light on the mysteries.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
